mapper.select: SELECT ar.id, ar.audit_no AS auditNo, ar.business_id AS businessId, ar.applicant_id AS applicantId, ar.current_status AS currentStatus, ar.priority, ar.title, ar.content, ar.attachments, ar.submit_time AS submitTime, ar.finish_time AS finishTime, ar.current_admin_id AS currentAdminId, a.name AS currentAdminName, ar.final_opinion AS finalOpinion, ar.reject_reason AS rejectReason FROM audit_record ar LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON ar.current_admin_id = a.id WHERE ar.id = #{id} AND ar.audit_type = 1 AND ar.is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, vehicle_number AS vehicleNumber, car_name AS carName, car_brand AS carBrand, car_type AS carType, vehicle_type AS vehicleType, current_type AS currentType, max_charge_voltage AS maxChargeVoltage, max_charge_current AS maxChargeCurrent, max_charge_power AS maxChargePower, battery_capacity AS batteryCapacity, discharge_power AS dischargePower, `range`, auth_status AS authStatus, create_time AS createTime FROM car_auth WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT id, name, phone, avatar, auth_vehicle AS authVehicle FROM user_info WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT al.id, al.admin_id AS adminId, a.name AS adminName, al.action, al.from_status AS fromStatus, al.to_status AS toStatus, al.opinion, al.create_time AS createTime FROM audit_log al LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON al.admin_id = a.id WHERE al.audit_id = #{auditId} ORDER BY al.create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE car_auth SET auth_status = #{authStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE user_info SET auth_vehicle = #{authVehicle}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN current_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS needSupplement FROM audit_record WHERE audit_type = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_record WHERE audit_type = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 AND finish_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(finish_time) = CURDATE()
